recent_release.title: Light Through His Love
recent_release.quote: “And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.”
recent_release.text: Books for Bibles Press presents its first anthology, featuring how God’s love shines even in the darkest places. Ten young authors showcase their talents in thought provoking stories, splashing the pages with rays of light.

about.text:
### Hi!

I’m Sarah Buitendyk, a young author who writes clean, contemporary, suspense, and fantasy with romance woven into the stories. My books, whether they are suspense, fantasy, or contemporary will feature Epic Adventures, close friendships, and common people thrust into uncommon situations. I hope you enjoy your visit to this little corner of the internet that is mine. You can learn more about what I am doing and who I am [here](about.html).
